reviewContext.userProblem: The uncommitted pair-multi work used an 'active pane + individual file list + L/R badges' model, and the user rejected it. Users need several LEFT/RIGHT comparisons listed as pairs. Choosing a pair should show both of its files at once.
requiredOutcomes: `chilla --compare a.png..b.png c.png..d.png` opens comparison view showing a.png | b.png with the list folded; expanding it shows two pair entries; choosing the second shows c.png | d.png.
`chilla --compare ../x.png..../y.png` resolves correctly; an ambiguous or missing SPEC, or `--compare` with no SPEC, exits non-zero with a clear error.
`chilla a.png b.png` opens one pair as in 0.4.0; `chilla a b c` opens the plain explicit file list as before 0.4.0; single-file and directory launches are unchanged.

No active-pane UI or L/R badges remain; '{' '}' and the eye icons toggle panes with the never-both-hidden rule; the list folds/expands via header toggle, left-edge strip, pane fold button and Shift+L.

Rust tests cover --compare parsing (split resolution, ambiguity, errors, order, dedup) and 2-file / 3-file classification; TypeScript DOM tests cover pair list rendering/selection, folded start, fold controls and shortcuts.
CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings, mise run test, and bunx biome check src all pass.
nonGoals: No filtering, sorting, pagination, drag or runtime editing of pairs.
No persistence of pair selection, pane visibility, zoom or scroll.
No change to GitHub / Git diff detection, directory startup, macOS Finder / open -a open-files, or list_directory.
Do not touch or commit pubpage/**, design-docs/specs/design-product-website.md, or untracked .riela/ directories.

No edits to src/features/workspace/CollapsePaneButton.tsx, src/features/keymap/**, src/features/workspace/workspaceShortcuts.tsx or src/features/pr-diff/PrDiffWorkspace.tsx: their uncommitted accepted-reuse changes stay as they are.
constraints: Each --compare SPEC is LEFT..RIGHT. Try every (overlapping) `..` occurrence as the split point. Exactly one split must leave two existing regular files; relative paths resolve against cwd. Zero or several valid splits, a missing file, or a bare --compare is a usage error with exit code 2.

--compare must be the first argument (after the stripped --verbose / --csv-first-row-header options) and cannot be mixed with positional paths. Pairs keep command-line order and are deduplicated on canonical (left, right).

Without --compare: exactly two distinct regular files -> one pair (0.4.0). One file, 3+ plain files (explicit file list), directories and Finder delivery keep their pre-existing behavior. The uncommitted 3+-files-as-pair change is reverted to 9aa3772.

The Rust StartupTarget::FilePairs / BrowserRoot::FilePair { pairs } and the TypeScript FilePairPaths / file_pair { pairs } contract change in the same change set. list_explicit_file_set returns to its 9aa3772 signature (no sourceOrder).

Remove the active-pane concept entirely: no activeSide, active class, aria-current pane marker, L/R/LR badges, or single-file assignment. Keep the eye icons, restore strip, hidden-pane zoom guard, +/- visible-pane zoom, and r reloading the shown pair.

Each worker edits only its plan's writePaths and records sha256 before and after each edited file in its own plan progress log. Evidence (data only) goes under tmp/pair-compare-20261116-01/<planId>/<attempt>/ and stays untracked. Mutating git commands (checkout, restore, stash) are forbidden; `git show 9aa3772:<path>` is read-only and allowed.
Follow AGENTS.md, rust-coding-standards and ts-coding-standards. Use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true. No emojis. No AI attribution in commit messages.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: StartupTarget::FilePairs { first: FilePairPaths, rest: Vec<FilePairPaths> } replaces FilePair, and BrowserRoot::FilePair { pairs: Vec<FilePairEntry> } keeps kind "file_pair".
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The type guarantees at least one pair, and one variant covers both the 2-file and the --compare launch (design-pair-view.md Startup Payload Contract).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: SPEC resolution tries every overlapping `..` byte index and requires exactly one split that leaves two existing files.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Paths such as `../a.png..../b.png` contain several `..`. Checking the filesystem picks the one correct split, and ambiguity is reported instead of guessed (design-pair-view.md Compare CLI).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A new PairListPane, not FileBrowserPane, renders the pair list. Pair state (pairs, selectedIndex, visibility) is a pure module owned by WorkspaceShell.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One entry per pair does not fit the file-row model. Keeping FileBrowserPane free of pair markers removes the rejected badge code (design-pair-view.md Pair List Pane, State Ownership).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Selecting a pair never changes pane visibility.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: This is a user requirement: a hidden pane stays hidden when the pair changes.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Two waves: rust, ts-contract, pair-view, file-browser and readme first; workspace second.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: WorkspaceShell consumes the contracts of ts-contract, pair-view and file-browser. Wave 1 tolerates tsc errors in WorkspaceShell.tsx, and wave 2 is the first full typecheck gate.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The workspace grep is word-bounded (grep -rnwE) and sourceOrderPaths / source_order_paths is retained (PCW-GREP-SOURCEORDER-01).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: sourceOrderPaths belongs to the 9aa3772 explicit_file_set contract. Only the rejected standalone sourceOrder option, prop and field are removed.

intentionalTradeoffs: Pair list has no filter or sort; command-line order is the only order.
Users with a custom workspace keymap section that replaces the defaults do not get { / } until they add them.
GUI launch verification is deferred to the parent session after the workflow; jsdom cannot confirm layout.
Line-number hints in the plans may drift after wave 1. Re-reading each file and recording sha256 before editing mitigates this.
supportedEdgeCases: `--compare A..B A..B` and a same-canonical-file variant -> one pair; `A..B B..A` -> two pairs.
`a...b` with files a, .b, a. and b -> ambiguity error listing both splits.
`--verbose --compare A..B` and `--compare A..B --csv-first-row-header=true` -> FilePairs with options applied.
`A B` -> one pair; `A A` -> File; `A B C` and `A B A` -> FileSet; dir + file -> the existing usage error.
Single-pair startup also starts folded; j/k do not wrap; Enter on the current pair is a no-op.
With the right pane hidden, selecting another pair keeps it hidden, and { is a no-op on the only visible pane.
{ / } are ignored outside pair mode and in editable fields; r reloads only the shown pair's two paths.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Pair view from macOS Finder / open -a delivery.
Synchronized zoom or scroll between panes.
Live updates when a paired file changes on disk.
